title: mki x es.EDU DIY Kits (Moritz Klein × Erica Synths)
summary: Introduction videos for the educational DIY modules designed by Moritz Klein with Erica Synths: VCO, VCA, envelope generator, sequencer, VCF, S&H/noise and mixer. Each kit comes with a manual that teaches the design on a breadboard.
